# QueueSelect

<!-- description:start -->
A dropdown select component for choosing a Tracker queue. Supports static queue lists, async search/suggest, icons, loading states, and confirmation dialogs before selection changes.
<!-- description:end -->

## Usage

```tsx
import {QueueSelect} from '@weavix/tracker-components';
import type {QueueInfo} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

const queues: QueueInfo[] = [
    {key: 'DEV', display: 'Development'},
    {key: 'DESIGN', display: 'Design'},
];

<QueueSelect
    queues={queues}
    defaultQueue={queues[0]}
    onChange={(queue) => console.log(queue)}
/>;
```

## Component props

<!-- props:start -->
```ts
{
    /**
     * List of queues to display in the dropdown.
     * Accepts either QueueInfo objects or plain queue key strings.
     */
    queues?: QueueInfo[] | string[];

    /**
     * The queue selected by default when the component mounts.
     * Accepts either a QueueInfo object or a plain queue key string.
     */
    defaultQueue?: QueueInfo | string;

    /**
     * Whether the component is in a loading state.
     * @default false
     */
    loading?: boolean;

    /**
     * Set of queue keys to exclude from the displayed list.
     */
    hideQueues?: ReadonlySet<string>;

    /**
     * Async callback invoked when the user types in the search filter.
     * Should return a promise resolving to a list of matching QueueInfo objects.
     * When provided, the component fetches suggestions on each filter change.
     */
    onSearch?: (text: string) => Promise<QueueInfo[]> | CancellablePromise<QueueInfo[]>;

    /**
     * Callback fired when the selected queue changes.
     */
    onChange?: (queue: QueueInfo) => void;

    /**
     * Callback fired when the select control is clicked/opened.
     */
    onSelectClick?: () => void;

    /**
     * When true, no queue is pre-selected on mount.
     * @default false
     */
    initialEmpty?: boolean;

    /**
     * When true, disables the search/filter input inside the dropdown.
     * @default false
     */
    withoutSuggest?: boolean;

    /**
     * When true, shows a queue icon next to the selected value in the control.
     * @default false
     */
    withValueIcon?: boolean;

    /**
     * Optional async guard called before applying a new selection.
     * Return { success: true } to allow the change, { success: false } to cancel it.
     */
    confirmUpdate?: () => Promise<{success: boolean}>;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the root element.
     */
    className?: string;

    /**
     * When true, renders a visible border around the control.
     * @default false
     */
    withBorder?: boolean;

    /**
     * Size of the select control.
     * @default 'm'
     */
    size?: 'xs' | 's' | 'm' | 'l' | 'xl';

    /**
     * Width of the dropdown popup in pixels, or 'fit' / 'outfit'.
     */
    popupWidth?: number | 'fit' | 'outfit';

    /**
     * Error message or boolean to display an error state on the control.
     */
    error?: string | boolean;

    /**
     * HTML id attribute for the underlying select control.
     */
    id?: string;

    /**
     * When false, hides the dropdown arrow indicator.
     */
    withArrow?: boolean;

    /**
     * Placeholder text shown when no queue is selected.
     */
    placeholder?: string;

    /**
     * Custom render function for the filter input inside the popup.
     */
    renderFilter?: (props: object) => React.ReactNode;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the inner control block.
     */
    controlClassName?: string;

    /**
     * When true, the dropdown popup renders inline instead of in a portal.
     * @default false
     */
    disablePortal?: boolean;
}
```

## Types

```ts
type QueueInfo = {
    /** Queue key, e.g. "DEV" */
    key: string;
    /** Human-readable queue name */
    display?: string;
    showDefaultCreationForm?: boolean;
    enableCloneMoveForAll?: boolean;
};

type QueueSuggestItem = {
    key: string;
    name?: string;
    showDefaultCreationForm?: boolean;
    enableCloneMoveForAll?: boolean;
};
```

---

## Tracker API

`QueueSelect` is data-agnostic — it accepts queues via the `queues` prop and search results via the `onSearch` callback. You are responsible for fetching data from the Tracker API and passing it to the component.

Requires the `"tracker:queues:read"` permission in your plugin's `manifest.json`:

```json
{
    "permissions": {
        "data": ["tracker:queues:read"]
    }
}
```

There are two fetch flows depending on whether the user has typed anything in the search filter.

### Flow 1 — Initial load (no user input)

When the dropdown opens without any search text, fetch the full queue list:

```ts
const result = await trackerApi.v3.get['/queues']();
return result.data; // QueueInfo[]
```

### Flow 2 — Suggest (non-empty user input)

When the user types in the filter, fetch suggestions using the suggest endpoint:

```ts
const result = await trackerApi.v3.get['/queues/_suggest']({
    queryParams: {input: text, fields: []},
});
return result.data; // QueueInfo[]
```

### Example: static initial list + async suggest

The example below loads queues once on mount (Flow 1) and switches to the suggest endpoint (Flow 2) as soon as the user starts typing.

```tsx
import React, {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
import {CancellablePromise} from '@gravity-ui/sdk';
import {QueueSelect} from '@weavix/tracker-components';
import type {QueueInfo} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

interface Props {
    trackerApi: TrackerApi; // your Tracker API client
    onChange: (queue: QueueInfo) => void;
}

export const QueueSelectWithApi: React.FC<Props> = ({trackerApi, onChange}) => {
    const [queues, setQueues] = useState<QueueInfo[]>([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

    // Flow 1 — fetch all queues on mount (no user input)
    useEffect(() => {
        trackerApi.v3
            .get['/queues']()
            .then((result) => setQueues(result.data))
            .finally(() => setLoading(false));
    }, [trackerApi]);

    // Flow 2 — suggest queues when the user types
    const handleSearch = (text: string): CancellablePromise<QueueInfo[]> => {
        const promise = trackerApi.v3
            .get['/queues/_suggest']({queryParams: {input: text, fields: []}})
            .then((result) => result.data);

        return new CancellablePromise(promise, () => {});
    };

    return (
        <QueueSelect
            queues={queues}
            loading={loading}
            onSearch={handleSearch}
            onChange={onChange}
            placeholder="Select a queue"
        />
    );
};
```
